name: sanity-css-eval-panda
description: Evaluation prototype: a @sanity/ui-style Button built with Panda CSS 2.x, published as a library with pre-generated CSS, with two versions rendered on one page to prove the absence of class-name collisions.

scripts.build: pnpm -r --filter './packages/*' run build && pnpm -r --filter './apps/*' run build
scripts.test: pnpm run test:static && pnpm run test:browser && pnpm run test:types && pnpm run check:vite && pnpm run check:postcss && pnpm run check:ssr
